Looking at the cuboid (3×2×2 = 12 cubes), the light gray block occupies the four cubes on the left (front-left column, front-bottom-middle, top-back-left), and the dark gray block occupies the four cubes on the right-front/top (front-top-middle, front-top-right, front-bottom-right, top-back-right).

The remaining four cubes must form the white block: the back-bottom row of three cubes (left, middle, right) plus the cube on top of the back-middle position. This is exactly the shape of a row of three cubes with one cube on top of the middle — a flat "T" shape.

Checking the options:
- A is an L-shape (row of 3 with cube on top of the end) — wrong.
- B is a zigzag/S-shape — wrong.
